faq.question: What does an AI voice agent cost per minute?
faq.answer: A typical managed stack costs $0.05–$0.15 per minute depending on telephony, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, LLM, and voice platform choices. Self-hosted stacks can drop variable cost close to $0 but add infrastructure labor.

faq.question: Which voice platform is cheapest?
faq.answer: Open-source frameworks like Pipecat have no platform fee, but you pay for compute, telephony, and APIs. Among managed platforms, Synthflow and Retell often have the lowest per-minute platform fees, while Vapi and Bland include more bundled orchestration.

faq.question: How much do AI voice agent telephony costs add?
faq.answer: US inbound local numbers typically cost $0.004–$0.009 per minute plus a $0.35–$1.15 monthly number fee. Outbound calls and SMS are billed separately; high-volume outbound use cases like reminders can make telephony the largest cost.

faq.question: Are LLM costs significant in voice agents?
faq.answer: For cheap models like GPT-4o mini, LLM cost is usually under $0.01 per minute. For GPT-4o or Claude Sonnet it can become the second- or third-largest cost, especially on long calls with large context windows.

faq.question: How do I price a voice-agent product with margin?
faq.answer: Use the cost-per-minute from this calculator, then divide by (1 − target margin). For example, if cost is $0.08/min and you want 30% gross margin, charge about $0.114/min. Add overhead and support costs on top for true net margin.
